question.worked_solution:
We have $\frac{1}{18}$ on the left and $\frac{7}{18}$ on the right.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129810/assets/c6793d1561b506960661c67a8f33e5c07f3c18bd1d1a9296519f134c0fd17e2f.png)

The shape on the left has $1$ shaded piece, and the shape on the right has $7$ shaded pieces. So, the number of shaded pieces has increased by a factor of $7.$

Therefore, the multiplication problem shown is

$$
\frac{1}{18}\times 7=\frac{7}{18}.
$$

So, the missing number is $7.$
